method: Frozen baseline cameras and width denominators. Re-associated candidate vertices remain reviewable; no camera or geometry optimization. Limited views still have no acceptance verdict.

views.status: Current model · limited reference; no acceptance verdict

not_a_reading: Re-measurement of the existing model and T-2200 source picks; no new historical adjudication.

dimension_controls.name: Prairie roof: street pitch
dimension_controls.source: HABS sheet 6: ridge 45.7 and eave 27.1 ft above door, scaled from the printed chimney datum; sheet 2: 26 ft 6 in range.
dimension_controls.tier: Inferred: ridge centered at W13.25; ±1 ft datum transfer is not a pitch survey.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain. Stronger vertical control than the earlier schematic section.

dimension_controls.name: Prairie roof: courtyard pitch
dimension_controls.source: Sheets 4 and 6; the model carries door +0.74 ft to north grade.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain provisionally. Sheet 4 gives a smaller rise; reconcile the two sheets before changing this slope.

dimension_controls.name: North roof: street / courtyard pitches
dimension_controls.source: HABS sheet 4 ridge controls; T-2016 planar interpolation and T-2183 projecting eave.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain the 34.1-ft ridge and continuous 24-ft projecting edge; do not restore the superseded kicked slope.

dimension_controls.name: West roof: full ridge / courtyard edge
dimension_controls.source: HABS northwest photograph; T-2235 owner-corrected full-length ridge and 2.36-ft courtyard overhang.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain the straight W141 ridge for all 59.75 ft. Do not reinstate the lowered rear roof.

dimension_controls.name: West cross-gable: north / south pitches
dimension_controls.source: T-2231 west-profile controls retained by T-2235; HABS photo 01 is oblique, not a roof survey.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain independent cross-gable. Neither the cropped Nickel detail nor an isolated west view establishes the hidden courtyard slope.

dimension_controls.name: Three courtyard dormers: centers
dimension_controls.source: HABS sheet 4, three drawn dormers; spacing re-read in section-readings.json.
dimension_controls.tier: Drawn fabric attested; scaled positions and 1904 carryback inferred.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain. Approximate raster spacings differ by 0.3–1.0 ft; they do not establish a displacement correction.

dimension_controls.name: Courtyard dormers: body / hood width
dimension_controls.source: Sheet 4 body/hood outlines; existing v4 hood projects 0.26 m per side.
dimension_controls.tier: Body scaled from drawing; exact hood projection reconstructed.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain flared hood. The section suggests a narrower outline, but approximate raster scale, caps and silhouette definitions need reconciliation first.

dimension_controls.name: Courtyard dormers: eave / apex / flare
dimension_controls.source: Sheet 4; existing v4 emitter. HABS 05 and Florian GX112.24 are textual visual cross-checks only here.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain existing two-slope hips and dark soffit. Roof apex and finial tip must be picked separately.

dimension_controls.name: West dormer: width / hood / height
dimension_controls.source: T-2235 connected hood; Nickel 1966–67 fragment is link-only, cropped and oblique.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain the connected hood. No complete, unobscured dated west view provides an independent width/height correction.

dimension_controls.name: Stair turret: radius / eave / apex
dimension_controls.source: HABS sheet 2 plan and sheet 4 elevation; ca.1923 court and 1948 detail cross-checks.
dimension_controls.tier: Retained fabric attested; scaled dimensions and 1904 carryback inferred.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain provisionally. Sheet 4 suggests about 7.54 ft cone rise versus 9.80 ft in the model; resolve the shared height disagreement and apex/tip definitions before shortening the turret.

dimension_controls.name: North tower: eave / apex / tip
dimension_controls.source: HABS section and north photographs; HABS 14 tip is partially screened by utility poles.
dimension_controls.tier: Inferred form and scaled heights; finial dimensions reconstructed.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain pending cross-view reconciliation. Do not lower the tower by converting a pixel residual directly to feet.

dimension_controls.name: Dining bay: actual outer width / projection
dimension_controls.source: HABS sheets 2–3 exterior polygon. The 17 ft 8 in × 11 ft room labels describe the interior.
dimension_controls.tier: Drawn plan attested; scaled exterior outline inferred.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain. Existing prose says 10.3 ft projection; actual coordinates give 9.90 ft. This is a description discrepancy, not a proven mesh defect.

dimension_controls.name: Dining bay: upper glazing / copper cap
dimension_controls.model: 20.90–24.00 ft ng; apex 34.10 ft; cap rise 10.10 ft
dimension_controls.source: T-2172/T-2183 retained alignment; HABS 05 is a later, restricted visual cross-check.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain the upper band and 9.3–14.5-ft principal lights. Do not repeat the superseded enlargement from an oblique photo ratio.

dimension_controls.name: Dining bay: shoulders / tiled connection
dimension_controls.model: S29.19 shoulders; S14.60 ridge connection; 14.59-ft run
dimension_controls.source: T-2157 copper hip and crested tiled connection; T-2183 continuous eave.
dimension_controls.tier: Reconstructed; exact apron dimensions not surveyed.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain the shoulder profile and joined roof. Visible northeast lifted copper belongs to T-2220.

dimension_controls.name: Hall bow: wall / low copper rise
dimension_controls.source: HABS sheet 4 low roof beyond the section; sheet 2 printed interior radius 9 ft 6 in; data p.21 copper sheathing.
dimension_controls.tier: Copper attested at survey date; hidden roof form reconstructed.
dimension_controls.decision: Retain the low bow. T-2220 must attach the cladding to its host and remove the fold, without reshaping the main roofs.
